advice.why: Going in short on it cost your recent work about 3.1 points a piece off the whole. That’s preparation, not training: give it more time before you show or tape your next piece.

Tiring through a piece’s later moments cost your recent work about 0.7 points a piece off the whole. Stamina is your fitness, and Work Out, under Look After Yourself, builds it. Places to breathe in a piece leave less of it to drain, and on a night so does coming to the curtain rested. Rest restores energy, not fitness.

20 hours of its exercise, an hour a day, would take it from 72 to about 75. On your recent work, judged again as you are now, that’s forecast to be worth about 0.5 points a piece (your last 12 pieces all call on it; The Cold Store (Afraid Of Herself), Taped would gain most, about +0.5). About 0.1 of that comes from the discipline 20 days of practice build, which any exercise kept up daily would bring too. Set Focus to Steady to start. Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old. It keeps coming back in your work: it has held back 15 of your pieces in all, 49.9 points off the whole across them.
